name: design-new-op
prompt: Design a Dragonfly (v1.34.0) Lua operation renew_leases_batch that renews up to 64 leases at once. Data: hash {t}:leases with field=mailbox_id and value 'token:deadline_ms'; zset {t}:due with member=mailbox_id score=deadline_ms. A lease renews only if the caller's token matches the stored token and the stored deadline is still in the future; on success the new deadline is now+ttl_ms (server time), both the hash and the zset are updated; the reply reports a per-item status (renewed / token_mismatch / expired / missing). Deliver renew_leases_batch.lua and DESIGN.md: KEYS/ARGV contract, reply shape, why the script is bounded and how, and exactly how you would measure its cost on Dragonfly before shipping.
expected_output: All keys declared in KEYS (two keys, one hashtag); one HMGET for the batch, one multi-field HSET and one multi-member ZADD for the successes (or acall for discarded results); explicit 64 bound and unpack chunking awareness; flat reply with constant arity and integer/string status codes; measurement plan names the eval coordination counters or SCRIPT LATENCY, identical-seed comparison, p50 and p99; no Redis-only advice.
assertions: both-keys-declared-in-keys: {t}:leases and {t}:due are both passed in KEYS, not constructed inside the script body
single-hmget-for-batch: the batch of up to 64 lease fields is read with one HMGET rather than per-item HGET
batched-hset-and-zadd-for-successes: successful renewals are written with one multi-field HSET and one multi-member ZADD (or equivalent single batched calls)
explicit-64-bound-and-chunking-awareness: the script enforces an explicit bound of 64 items and shows awareness of unpack/argument-count chunking limits
per-item-status-stable-protocol: the reply carries a per-item status covering renewed/token_mismatch/expired/missing with a stable constant-arity protocol
server-time-used-for-deadline: the new deadline is computed from server time obtained on the server, per the stated contract
measurement-plan-names-script-latency-and-equal-seed: the verification note names SCRIPT LATENCY or the eval coordination counters, an identical-seed comparison, and p50 plus p99
no-unverified-redis-only-advice: the design contains no Redis-origin performance advice presented without Dragonfly evidence
